summary: Completed live frontend smoke and route-wide testing. Login validation, authenticated routing, dashboard filters, student search/profile navigation, mobile menu, logout, and mobile overflow checks passed. No backend API exists; all data flows are LOCAL MOCK DATA.

ui_bugs.issue: The Main Dashboard element is rendered as a button without an onClick or navigation target. From any non-dashboard route, users cannot return to /dashboard via the sidebar.

action_items: Replace the static Main Dashboard sidebar button with a NavLink to /dashboard.

Add descriptive data-testid attributes to critical page controls and information on Admissions, Batches, Employees, Attendance, Class Reports, Tasks, Performance, and Reports, plus Registration fields.
Add backend/API integration if persistence is required; current CRUD-like flows reset on reload and are LOCAL MOCK DATA.
critical_code_review_comments: Walk-in and registration saves only update component state, so created records are not persistent across route reloads.
Fee updates allow independent edits to pending amount and do not recalculate it until registration save; this may permit inconsistent fee totals.
Many interactive controls have no data-testid, preventing robust automated coverage of requested flows.
seed_data_creation: None; existing local mock data only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live app tested at http://localhost:5173. Unauthenticated /dashboard redirected to /login. Valid demo login used admin@example.com/secret. All listed routes loaded. Mobile 390px had no horizontal overflow and menu opened. Console error list was empty during tested flows.
test_credentials: The referenced /app/memory/test_credentials.md file was missing. Demo credentials were supplied by the task and accepted by the local form.
rca of the issue: Sidebar.tsx renders Main Dashboard as a plain button at lines 79-83, while only navigation.slice(1) is mapped to NavLink components. It has no navigation handler, so clicking it cannot change location. Use a NavLink (or navigate('/dashboard')) and preserve active styling.
